name: ts-mancho
description: Quiet diagnostic presentation, JS/TS typing pulse, pause-based save, and one-click formatting.

tsMancho.quietMode.description: Hide diagnostic decorations across the editor with Problems visibility, plus JS/TS unused hints and inline Error Lens messages. Validation, IntelliSense and build checks stay enabled.

tsMancho.smoothTyping.description: Enable native smooth caret animation, smooth blinking and scrolling.

tsMancho.typingPulse.description: Briefly highlight the latest newly typed character without changing source text.

tsMancho.autoSaveAfterTyping.description: Save dirty local files after typing pauses when native afterDelay Auto Save is not already active.

tsMancho.autoSaveDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds for the extension's pause-based save. Native files.autoSaveDelay takes precedence when native afterDelay mode is enabled.

tsMancho.showFormatButton.description: Show a Format button in the status bar; use the editor's configured formatter.
